title: iPad mini (A20 Pro) review: Apple's tiny tablet gets a big update
method: Hands-on review of a 256 GB model with nano-texture glass.

findings.subject: apple-ipad-mini-a20-pro
findings.text: The first OLED screen in an iPad mini gives deep blacks and much better HDR; nano-texture glass makes it easy to use near bright lights. It stays at 60 Hz, a let-down at this price.

findings.subject: apple-ipad-mini-a20-pro
findings.text: The new speakers have much stronger bass; the previous iPad mini sounds tinny next to it.

findings.subject: apple-ipad-mini-a20-pro
findings.text: The A20 Pro handled everything, including console ports such as Control and No Man's Sky.

findings.subject: apple-ipad-mini-a20-pro
findings.text: From $699, $200 more than the last model at launch; nano-texture glass needs the $899 256 GB model, so the reviewer doubts it is worth it for most people.

title: Honor Pad 20 Review: An iPad Air rival for £250 less
method: Full review with daily use as a media and work tablet.

findings.subject: honor-pad-20
findings.text: The 12.1-inch 3K LCD is well calibrated and bright enough indoors, though rated at only 700 nits.

findings.subject: honor-pad-20
findings.text: Six speakers sound good for a tablet this thin (6.39 mm, 548 g).

findings.subject: honor-pad-20
findings.text: Long battery life from a large battery.

findings.subject: honor-pad-20
findings.text: At £499 it undercuts the iPad Air by £250, but the keyboard and stylus cost about £95 more and the software is cluttered.

title: Google Pixel Buds 2a Review
method: Long-term review since October 2025, compared with budget rivals.

findings.subject: google-pixel-buds-2a
findings.text: Noise cancelling matches the first Pixel Buds Pro once the ear tips seal well; the tips run small, and ANC strength can't be adjusted.

findings.subject: google-pixel-buds-2a
findings.text: At about £100 they are fantastic value; at £129 still a strong choice.

title: Vivo X500 Pro camera review: Battle of the small(er) phones vs Pixel 11 Pro
method: Camera comparison of the X500, X500 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro on a day of shooting.

findings.subject: vivo-x500-pro
findings.text: Zoom shots at 5x and 10x are nearly noise-free and detailed; its telephoto sensor pulls out more detail than the X500's.

findings.subject: google-pixel-11-pro
findings.text: Pixel photos look softer and more natural, which some will prefer, and the Pixel takes the photo noticeably faster.
